summary: SafeSpace Global Corp filed an 8-K reporting an equity line of credit (ELOC) purchase agreement and registration rights agreement with Crom Structured Opportunities Fund I, LP, dated September 18, 2026, closing September 21, 2026. The company may, at its discretion but with no obligation, issue and sell up to $10,000,000 of newly issued common stock over a 36-month commitment period, subject to registration effectiveness and advance mechanics with a five-trading-day gap between advances. This is a routine at-the-market-style financing facility, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch dilution risk and registration effectiveness.
